questions.stem: How does a nerve impulse cross the gap (synapse) between two neurones?

options.text: The electrical impulse jumps across the gap
The impulse travels backwards along the second neurone
The neurones physically touch to pass the impulse
Chemicals called neurotransmitters diffuse across the gap

questions.explanation: At a synapse, the electrical impulse triggers the release of chemical neurotransmitters which diffuse across the small gap and stimulate a new electrical impulse in the next neurone.
